title: JUKI LH-3528A-7
subtitle: Semi-Dry-Head 2-Needle Lockstitch Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI LH-3528A-7 is a semi-dry-head 2-needle lockstitch sewing machine used for parallel double-stitch seaming operations such as shirt yokes, waistbands, decorative topstitching, and inseam / outseam work on jeans and trousers.
applications: Double-needle topstitching on shirt yokes, pockets, and plackets
Decorative parallel stitching on jeans, trousers, and workwear
Waistband and yoke assembly on woven garments
Operations requiring switchable needle-feed / bottom-feed feeding
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (shirts, jeans, trousers, workwear), uniform manufacturing

overviewDescription: The JUKI LH-3528A-7 is a semi-dry-head 2-needle lockstitch machine. It features switchable needle feed and bottom feed, a direct-drive mechanism, a new thread tension control, and improved oiling. The semi-dry head keeps the needle bar area dry to prevent oil staining on light fabrics, while the hook area is automatically lubricated. The machine is widely used on shirt and trouser production lines for parallel-stitch operations.

classificationTable.value: Changeover between needle feed and bottom feed

technicalSpecs.value: Semi-dry head (needle bar area dry, hook area lubricated)

finalNotes:
• The 'semi-dry head' design minimizes oil staining on light fabrics — useful for white and pastel shirts where oil contamination is a defect.
• The switchable needle-feed / bottom-feed mechanism lets the operator switch feeding mode for different fabric types without changing machines.
